query.description: Rows of one DOL dataset (catalog alias or AGENCY/api_url), with filters, fields and sort. Needs DOL_API_KEY.

filters.desc: {field: value} equals; {field: [a, b]} in; {field: {"gt": x, "lt": y, "neq": z, "like": "%x%"}}

search.desc: {field: text}: substring match tolerant of case (OR of the text as typed, UPPER, lower, Title)

state.desc: two-letter state code, applied to the dataset's state field (osha_inspection site_state, whd_enforcement st_cd, eta_ui_state_weekly_claims st)

filter_object.desc: raw DOL filter_object (JSON object or string); combined with AND with the above

sort_by.desc: field to sort by (default: the dataset's date field)

datasets.description: The DOL API data catalog (keyless): id, agency, api_url, name, frequency, tags.

dataset_info.description: Field dictionary of one dataset (keyless): column_name, data_type, column_desc.

dataset_id.desc: numeric dataset id, or a catalog alias (resolved to its dataset_id)

ui_trust_fund.description: ETA 2112 UI financial transaction summary (keyless; DOL Office of Unemployment Insurance): each state's unemployment fund by month since 1979, in dollars: balances (balance_close_utf = the state account in the Unemployment Trust Fund), deposits (UI tax contributions, Treasury interest, reimbursements, federal shares), disbursements (benefits paid), with readable column names (the file's c1..c136 codes, mapped in 'columns'). Filter by state and month after the download (one 23 MB CSV).

state.desc: two-letter state code or a list (53 jurisdictions incl. DC, PR, VI)

start.desc: first month, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (rptdate is the month's last day)

latest.desc: true: keep only each state's most recent month (states report with different lags)

fields.desc: columns to keep (readable names or c-codes; st and rptdate always kept); default all

ui_data_summary.description: UI Data Summary tables for the latest calendar-year quarter (keyless; quarterly): one row per state and the United States. Sheet Financial (default: revenues, net trust fund balance, trust fund balance, Title XII loan balance, interest earned, in $ thousands; taxable wage base), Wage and Tax Rate (tax rates, trust fund as % of total wages, average high cost multiple AHCM, high cost multiple HCM; two quarters behind), Regular Benefits, Benefits and Duration, Labor Force. The quarter is in the cyq column (2026.2 = April-June 2026).

sheet.desc: Financial (default), Wage and Tax Rate, Regular Benefits, Benefits and Duration or Labor Force
